item.title: LPG crisis hits Dhaka eateries hard
item.description: Dhaka's restaurants are facing severe disruptions as a shortage of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) hits kitchens across the city. Despite official data showing stable imports and adequate stocks, restaurant operators report steep price hikes and limited supply, threatening daily operations.At Sky Lounge in Mirpur-1, assistant manager Saad Bin Siraj said the restaurant typically requires around 10 cylinders a day but often receives only two or three. item.title: Consumers caught off guard over pricy rice
item.description: Rice prices have increased significantly in the capital's markets over the past week, catching low-income consumers off guard.The price of old rice has risen by Tk 3 to Tk 5 per kg ahead of the arrival of new rice, leaving many households uneasy.This scenario was observed after visiting several markets in the capital on Friday.Prices of Miniket and Nazirshail rice have increased by up to Tk 5 per kg over the past week. The price of Manjur and Sagar brand Miniket rice has gone up by Tk 3 to Tk 4

item.title: Iran leader says protesters are vandals trying to please Trump
item.description: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has called anti-government protesters "troublemakers" who are trying "to please the president of the US".Iran also sent sent a letter to the United Nations Security Council blaming the US for turning the protests into what it called "violent subversive acts and widespread vandalism" in Iran. item.title: Daily Observer's Naogaon correspondent Obaidur passes away
item.description: The Daily Observer's Naogaon district correspondent Md Obaidur Rahman passed away on Friday night at a hospital in Naogaon. He was 70.He breathed his last around 11:30PM while undergoing treatment at Naogaon Sadar Hospital.According to the family, Obaidur Rahman had been suffering from various complications.He left behind wife, two children and a host of relatives to mourn his death.TF
